name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'Open the door' unconditionally and without a preference cue, so it needs a hard Existence(door_open). The 'if possible' cue scopes only 'pick up the box', which correctly stays soft, but the current clause Response(door_open, target_picked_up) soft alone makes no goal happen and FINAL_STATES is empty. Add a hard Existence(door_open); the Response clause's condition should keep door_open as a condition, not a goal, so the goal clause is the fix.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) is hard as the unconditional command 'Open the door', and the soft Response(door_open, target_picked_up) captures the preference 'if possible, pick up the box'. The box is only a preference, so no hard goal for it is required.

texts: If possible, pick up the box after the door is open.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u1) -> 6
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
